name: Purchase Path
thesis: Put time and tradeoffs before a purchase recommendation.
composition: A reading-led comparison with a single timing decision instead of dashboard cards.
interaction: Switch timing scenarios and inspect the corresponding explanation.
rationale: A product-specific test candidate, not an approved financial product.
signature: A two-date decision surface that changes its guidance in place
asset_strategy: Product-owned typography and decision copy; no decorative stock imagery
motion_rationale: The status replacement connects the selected date to its consequence without decorative animation.
responsive_strategy: The timing choices and explanation remain a single reading column on narrow screens.
reduced_motion: The selected explanation updates instantly with persistent labels and no interpolation.
